description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::cord_internal namespace, specifically testing the statistics collection and thread safety of CordzInfo objects and related data structures in the Abseil library.

methods.name: PrintTo
methods.description: Prints a placeholder representation of CordzStatistics to an output stream.

methods.name: Substring

methods.description: Calculates the allocated size of various CordRep types.

methods.description: Recursively computes the fair share memory usage of a CordRep.
